name: plaid-importer
description: Import bank, card and brokerage data from Plaid into Wealthfolio

scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && find dist -name '*.map' -delete && zip -r dist/$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json dist/addon.js README.md -x '*.map'
scripts.bundle: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm package
scripts.wf:up: f=test/docker/.env; [ -f $f ] || echo "WF_SECRET_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 32)" > $f; docker compose -p plaid-wf -f test/docker/compose.yml --env-file $f up -d --wait
scripts.wf:down: docker compose -p plaid-wf -f test/docker/compose.yml --env-file test/docker/.env down
scripts.wf:reset: docker compose -p plaid-wf -f test/docker/compose.yml --env-file test/docker/.env down -v && rm -f test/docker/.env
